The installed thin drip-tape laterals with neutral seedlings align with the requested technical evidence. The layout is clean, the product is fully visible and count-matches. The only minor advisory observation is that the laterals stop just short of the carton's right edge; a slightly larger clearance would be ideal, but the current spacing is acceptable and does not constitute a core defect.
